_what: A summary an AI keeps of one conversation (src/thread-summaries.mjs), so the next AI that opens the thread reads a few lines instead of every message, and knows whether newer messages have come since. The record type, the size and every word are rows here.

words.needs_conversation: Name the conversation: conversation_id (and app) as read_messages shows them.
words.nothing_there: That conversation has no messages to summarize.
words.none_yet: No summary is kept for this conversation yet. Read its messages with read_messages, then keep a summary with save_thread_summary.
words.stale: {count} newer message(s) since this was written. Read them with read_messages and keep a new summary with save_thread_summary.
words.removed: Removed the summary of this conversation.
